internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every occurrence in this packet is the noun juz' meaning 'a part/portion of a whole' — a divided or assigned share of some larger set (people apportioned to Hell's gates, physical pieces of the four birds, a subset of God's servants falsely attributed to Him). Critically, despite the packet label 'ج ز ا / jzA', not one token carries the sense of recompense/reward/requital (jazā', a distinct root ج ز ي that is absent here); that gloss is an orthographic-label false prior to be excluded, not imported.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: juz' does NOT mean recompense/reward/requital (that is root jzy, absent from this packet — the transliteration/label match is spurious). It does NOT denote the whole/totality — it is inherently a proper sub-portion indexing a larger set. It carries NO intrinsic moral valence: neutral in 15:44 and 2:260, the condemnation in 43:15 attaches to the object (attributing offspring to God) and the verb ja'alū, not to juz'. It is NOT a vague quantifier 'some' — 15:44's juz'un maqsūm marks a bounded, apportioned share. It has NO fixed magnitude. It does NOT require literal physical severance — apportionment/designation (15:44, 43:15) qualifies as much as physical partition (2:260).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 43:15:5:1 (min 'ibādihi juz'an). Unlike the enumerated apportionment of 15:44 and the concrete physical fragment of 2:260, nothing is literally divided here; juz' names an attributed/derivative constituent of God (offspring), which could be read as a mere subset ('some of His servants') with no real partition — threatening the partition/division component of the nucleus. It bends but does not break the account: the polemic ('inna l-insāna la-kafūrun mubīn') is intelligible only if juz' means 'a constituent part making up a whole,' and the surface min 'ibādihi preserves the partitive-of-a-whole frame. It therefore defeats the narrower 'physical severed piece' reading and caps the nucleus at the more abstract 'constituent portion of a specifiable whole,' rather than establishing a resistant second class.

rejection_condition.search_location: The three attested tokens (15:44:7:1, 2:260:30:1, 43:15:5:1) and any future-confirmed occurrences of the hamzated root; specifically re-examine the min-partitive framing and the governing verb (q-s-m in 15:44, j-'-l in 2:260/43:15).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Confirm surface form is juz' (juzo'…, hamzated) via qac_surface_form_buckwalter; test whether a larger whole is named/entailed and whether juz' picks out a proper sub-portion of it versus the totality or an unbounded amount; check for any q-s-m/j-'-l or min-partitive scaffolding.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude the recompense root jzy (jazā', ج ز ي) — a morphologically distinct hamza-less/yā' root; do not admit any token on the basis of the packet's label 'ج ز ا / jzA' or transliteration match. rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a token is found, the single-nucleus 'partitive constituent of a whole' account is falsified or must split; the result would move toward UNRESOLVED/multi-class (or, if the requital sense appeared, would confirm root-label contamination and require repacketing), and the MODERATE grade would drop.

reopen_conditions: If a new confirmed occurrence of the hamzated root surfaces in a verbal, plural, or non-juz' derivational form, reopen to test whether the root contribution extends beyond the single lexicalized noun juz' (current MODERATE grade rests on morphological uniformity of these 3 tokens).
